sentence_stem: I wish I had more time,
correct_completion: so I could finish the project.
full_sentence: I wish I had more time, so I could finish the project.
acceptable_variants: so I would be able to finish the project.
which would let me finish the project.

options.text: so I finish the project now.
options.why_wrong: After 'so I could', the verb must be in the past modal form 'could finish'. The present form does not express the unreal result of the wish.

options.text: so I could finish the project.
because I am finishing it today.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a real cause. The wish is about a situation that is not true now, so it needs an unreal result.

options.text: so I have finished the project.
options.why_wrong: 'Have finished' describes a completed action, which does not fit the unreal result that follows 'I wish'.

grammar_focus: Wish with past simple for unreal present situations
explanation: After 'I wish' with the past simple, the speaker describes a present situation that is not true, and the result clause uses could plus the base verb. Spanish speakers may use a present form here because Spanish expresses wishes with a different mood, but English uses the past simple after wish to show an unreal present.
translation: Ojalá tuviera más tiempo para terminar el proyecto.
